summary: The reftests cover a broad set of rendering and layout improvements: WebRender now handles image sampling, CSS and SVG filters, border radii, shadows, sticky positioning, and top-layer elements more accurately, while text and SVG tests better account for device pixels, zoom, writing modes, and platform antialiasing. The work also improves browser chrome details such as rounded scrollbar boundaries, native-menubar icons, Nova checkbox and radio styling, centered cropping for privileged HTML labels, and deeply nested option lists. Several changes tidy test coverage and preferences, including better handling of unsupported scrollbars and platform-specific skips.
